item.title: AOC Condemns Spain For Stealing Mexico’s Language
item.description: MUNICH — In a bold declaration against colonial imperialism, U.S. Congresswoman Alexandro Ocasio-Cortez spoke out this week to condemn Spain for stealing Mexico's language.

item.title: Trump Replaces Pam Bondi With Broom In Blonde Wig
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — In a long-rumored shake-up at a high-level position in his administration, President Donald Trump announced that he had replaced Attorney General Pam Bondi with a broom in a blonde wig.

item.title: Wife Asks For Husband's Opinion So She Can Choose The Opposite Of Whatever He Says
item.description: STOCKTON, CA — According to sources, local wife Gillian Franks went to her husband to ask for his opinion on a minor decision so she would understand exactly how he felt and could then proceed to do the exact opposite of whatever he said.

item.title: Group Chat Ruined By Android User
item.description: U.S. — A group chat amongst friends was reportedly derailed and later abandoned altogether after being ruined by the presence of an Android user, according to reports.

item.title: Japan Agrees To Trade Deal After Trump Catches Five Shrimp In A Row In His Mouth During Lunch
item.description: BETHESDA, MD — A significant victory was notched by the current administration today, as Japan agreed to a trade deal after President Donald Trump successfully caught five shrimp in a row in his mouth during lunch.
